description: Trigger precision eval: verify ue-livecoding-fix activates on live coding/hot reload failure queries and NOT on general debug/build/scaffold queries

cases.reason: Korean '라이브 코딩 실패' — core trigger
English 'hot reload failed' — direct trigger (avoids 'error' → ue-debug, 'build' → ue-scaffold)
Korean '핫 리로드' — hot reload trigger (avoids '에러' → ue-debug)
English 'live coding' with specific code (avoids 'error' → ue-debug)
Korean '패치 실패' — patch failed trigger
English 'live coding' + 'patch failed' — combined trigger
Korean '라이브 코딩' + '패치 실패' — combined triggers (avoids '안돼' → ue-debug)

cases.query: hot reload failed on latest change
cases.reason: English 'hot reload failed' — exact pattern match (avoids unmatched 'failing')
Routes to ue-debug (higher-priority overlap): Ambiguous: "원인 찾아줘" matches ue-debug (lower priority); need "핫 리로드 실패" to be more specific
English 'patch failed' — specific context
TN: '에러 해결' is ue-debug trigger. General build error, not live coding specific.
TN: Runtime crash is ue-debug trigger. Not live coding/hot reload.
TN: '빌드' is ue-build-automate trigger. Full build, not live coding patch.
TN: '만들어줘' is ue-scaffold trigger. Creation, not hot reload fix.

cases.query: Explain how live coding works in UE
cases.reason: TN: 'Explain how' is ue-explain trigger. Understanding live coding, not fixing it.
TN: Linker error is ue-debug trigger. General compile error, not live coding.
TN: '진단' is ue-audit trigger. Project health, not live coding fix.
TN: Cook/package is ue-build-automate trigger. Build pipeline, not hot reload.
TN: '리팩터링' is ue-cpp-refactor trigger. Code refactoring, not hot reload fix.
TN: Compile error analysis is ue-debug trigger. General compile, not live coding patch.
